summary: Carbon County, WY lookout built 1949, out of service in the 1970s and moved in 1986 to the Grand Encampment Museum, where it still stands; the original site has no tower.

facts.status_note: Moved in 1986 to the Grand Encampment Museum in Encampment, WY; Firelookout.org lists no tower at the original site

access.note: Museum is open to visitors with a guided tour per a visit report; the report does not say whether the tower can be entered. Hours not checked. No access rule found for the original site.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Medicine Bow-Routt National Forest)

events.note: Built 1949 as a 50-foot all-steel live-in tower that replaced the Barrett Ridge lookout
Moved to the Grand Encampment Museum; the Register gives 1986
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register as US 2105, WY 7 on January 1, 2026

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives 9,574 ft (2,918 m); Firelookout.com gives 9,567 ft. The story uses the Register figure and names the other.
The Register says Medicine Bow-Routt National Forest; Firelookout.com says Medicine Bow National Forest. The story uses the Register's name.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: relocated status, Carbon County, coordinates and elevation (2,918 m) match the Register, and the FFLOS registration date of January 1, 2026 is confirmed. No record errors found, so no corrections. Original site: no source describes remains or access, and it was not visited. Museum tower: standing per the Firelookout.org index; access rests on one visit report, and the museum's own page was not read, so hours and whether the tower can be entered are unverified. The Register's agency line is used for agency. Budget: 2 WebSearch and about 5 page reads, within limits.
